title: A number plus a term stays open
note: $2 + 3x$ is a finished object — it does not collapse to $5x$. Only like terms combine ($x + x = 2x$); $2$ and $3x$ are not like.

title: Terms with different variables stay open
note: 3x + 2y cannot combine into one term — x and y are different objects. 5xy would be a product, something else entirely.

title: A power plus a term stays open
note: x² + x has two unlike terms — it is not x³. Exponents grow when powers are multiplied (x² · x = x³), never when they are added.
